description: List recent HTTP/HTTPS network requests captured on the tab with optional filters by URL, method, resourceType, and navigation history (includePreserved/navigationId).

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

includePreserved.description: Include network requests preserved across earlier navigations (default: true; set false for current navigation only)

method.description: Filter by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE...)

navigationId.description: Optional navigationId to filter network requests to a specific navigation

resourceType.description: Filter by resource type (Fetch, XHR, Document, Script...)
